tools.name: register_mentee
tools.description: Legacy in-chat email signup for MCP clients that do NOT manage OAuth Connect (no Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT Connect). If the client sends Authorization or apply returns use_connect/token_expired, use Connect (/mcp) instead — never call this on Connect clients.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Legacy in-chat email confirmation for non-Connect MCP clients only. Returns a Bearer JWT only if the client will send it on later requests (most Connect clients will not). If Authorization is already sent, returns use_connect — run /mcp instead. Never invent the code.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return the signed-in mentee's name, email, credit balance, and a one-use dashboard URL. Requires Authorization: Bearer.

tools.name: top_up_credits
tools.description: Top up the signed-in mentee's credit balance. Mentorships are billed from credits, not from a Stripe Connect subscription on the agent's card. Without an MPP credential this returns payment_required. MCP clients cannot send HTTP Payment headers — pass payment_credential (Stripe shared payment token

tools.name: open_dashboard
tools.description: Mint a one-use browser URL that signs the mentee into their dashboard. kind is 'applications' (default), 'home', or 'mentorship' (pass mentorship_hash). Requires Authorization: Bearer. The link expires in 30 minutes and works once.

tools.name: apply_to_mentor
tools.description: Send a mentorship application to a mentor on the signed-in mentee's behalf. Requires Authorization: Bearer and a verified email. goal must be a real, specific message (min 50 characters). Optional plan_hash selects a pricing plan from get_sessions_or_services. tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List the signed-in mentee's open applications (draft, sent, pending payment, accepted). Requires Authorization: Bearer. Use pay_application when payable is true.

tools.name: pay_application
tools.description: Pay for an accepted application from the mentee's credit balance. Requires Authorization: Bearer. If credits are short this returns payment_required. MCP clients cannot send HTTP Payment headers — pass payment_credential if the host wallet provides an MPP object, or use open_dashboard and pay in the

tools.name: list_mentorships
tools.description: List the signed-in mentee's active mentorships with dashboard URLs. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Use open_dashboard with kind=mentorship and mentorship_hash to mint a one-use login link.

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Read one application the signed-in mentee owns: status, action_required, whether they can withdraw, and the Pinax message thread. Requires Authorization: Bearer. application_hash comes from list_applications.

tools.name: send_application_message
tools.description: Send a message on an open application's Pinax thread. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Use this before mentorship starts. After an active mentorship exists, use send_message instead. Do not include scheduling links.

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw an open application the signed-in mentee owns. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Only works when list/get_application reports can_withdraw true (sent at least two days ago, no intro session). This cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description:
Generate booking deep-links for an ONGOING MENTORSHIP (subscription / PricingPlan). Returns:
  - apply_url: where the user starts the subscription. Optional     plan_hash pre-selects a specific plan.
  - inquiry_url: free question before committing (no booking).
  - requires_intro_call: when true, t

tools.name: list_intro_call_slots
tools.description: List open intro-call slots for an accepted application. Requires Authorization: Bearer. Available only when the mentor accepted and the intro call is not yet scheduled. Pick a start and call book_intro_call.

tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.description: Book an intro call on an accepted application. Requires Authorization: Bearer. start is an ISO-8601 datetime from list_intro_call_slots. Does not retry other slots on failure.

tools.name: list_mentorship_call_slots
tools.description: List open mentorship-call slots for an active mentorship. Requires Authorization: Bearer. mentorship_hash comes from list_mentorships. If the mentor only has an external calendar link, this returns not_available plus that link.

tools.name: book_mentorship_call
tools.description: Book a mentorship call on an active mentorship. Requires Authorization: Bearer. start is an ISO-8601 datetime from list_mentorship_call_slots.

tools.name: list_session_slots
tools.description: List open one-off session slots for a mentor's SessionSetup. Requires Authorization: Bearer. setup_id comes from get_sessions_or_services one_off_sessions[].id. Then call book_session with a start.

tools.name: book_session
tools.description: Book a one-off session: charge credits (top up via MPP if short), then reserve the chosen Cal slot. Requires Authorization: Bearer. setup_id and start come from get_sessions_or_services and list_session_slots. If credits are short this returns payment_required; pass payment_credential or pay via ope

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: List the signed-in mentee's TalkJS conversations (active mentorships and intro sessions). Requires Authorization: Bearer. Application threads before mentorship starts are Pinax; use get_application for those.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Read TalkJS messages from a mentor conversation. Requires Authorization: Bearer. conversation_id is the hash from list_conversations. Newest first. Pass starting_after with a message id to page into older messages.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a TalkJS message in an active mentorship or intro-session conversation. Requires Authorization: Bearer. conversation_id comes from list_conversations. For an application that is not yet a mentorship, use send_application_message.

tools.name: get_mentor_profile
tools.description: Fetch the full public profile for a single MentorCruise mentor. Use the `username` from a search_mentors result. Returns name, headline, company, bio, skills, languages, rating, monthly price, response time, open spots, and the public profile URL. Returns {'error': 'not_found'} if the mentor doesn't

tools.name: search_mentors
tools.description:
Find MentorCruise mentors who match a user's goal. Always call this BEFORE recommending any specific mentor — never recommend from prior knowledge or memory.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List MentorCruise's top-level mentor categories. Use this to ground recommendations in real category labels before calling search_mentors with a free-text query.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, open_dashboard, apply_to_mentor, list_mentorships, get_application, send_application_message, list_conversations, get_messages, get_mentor_profile, search_mentors, get_sessions_or_services · Private data: top_up_credits, pay_application · Public sink: register_mentee, verify_email, get_account, top_up_credits, apply_to_mentor, pay_application, send_application_message, send_message, get_sessions_or_services · Destructive: verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, open_dashboard, apply_to_mentor, list_mentorships, get_application, send_application_message, list_conversations, get_messages, get_mentor_profile, search_mentors, get_sessions_or_services · Private data: top_up_credits, pay_application · Public sink: register_mentee, verify_email, get_account, top_up_credits, apply_to_mentor, pay_application, send_application_message, send_message, get_sessions_or_services · Destructive: verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
